responsibility: This file performs the main semantic resolution pass over gfortran namespaces, symbols, expressions, interfaces, and executable code. It assigns and validates types, resolves procedure interfaces, ordinary assignments, function and subroutine calls, allocation expressions, derived-type components, intrinsic calls, and symbol attributes, checks declarations, initializers, DATA/EQUIVALENCE/COMMON usage, purity and control-flow rules, OpenMP/OpenACC semantics, and statement/code consistency, then drives code-resolution and final front-end optimization passes for each program unit. It is the central file for errors that appear after parsing but before Fortran lowering, when a syntactically valid program is accepted, rejected, typed, or connected to procedures incorrectly.
